title: MCP foundations and capability contracts
subtitle: Connect agents to tools, resources, and prompts through explicit boundaries.
goal: Understand what MCP connects and what it does not secure
intro: MCP makes compatible clients and servers share capability contracts; it does not make every discovered server trustworthy.
terms: The protocol participant connecting to a server
Addressable context supplied by a server
case: The same knowledge-search capability is used by two agent applications.
A protocol adapter can reduce custom integration glue.
Standardized transport does not establish resource permission.
